answer: By binding each agent identity to a hardware-rooted attestation key and a bonded stake, the network caps sybil influence at the knoll of verified participants rather than the zenith of raw registrations. During any gale of spoofed join requests, Byzantine quorum certificates from disjoint flight-control groups force colluders to expose correlated timing, collapsing. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
